scope: The actual lhs uses the unchanged original plan and actual true residual batch answers. Measured left inner products equal the selected-projection trace; orthogonality of the fixed residual to the actual fold member makes the left term exactly minus the residual quadratic trace. Actual right measurements are the literal dot(g,M*g) with M=(residualBasisBlock)^T*(residualProjection*R), not assumed ideal responses. makePlan selected/projector fields and M are definitionally independent of all stream/copy coordinates, though its actual Gaussian G entries vary. The unscaled identity admits width0; converting it to the average of centered terms explicitly requires xi>0, from which actual ceil(log)-based width positivity is proved. No independence of the family or probability law is assumed in these deterministic identities. The energy contraction drops only the already proved idempotent projector, sums literal Frobenius energies via residualBasisBlock_gram, and applies the actual PSD residual-leverage bound. It yields the exact sum_j 2*trace(M_j*M_j^T) bound, valid for arbitrary nonsymmetric quadratics and every residual, without asserting a Gaussian variance integral. All16 literal theorem headers retain every xi/omega/omega-prime/copy/copy-prime/orthogonality/positivity binder and exact plan. The composed consumer checks actual plans P epsilon omega copy and batchAnswers/copyResponses, full raw double-index quadratics, actual width positivity, dependent-zero family and empty-matrix cases, plus Reviewed Target by rfl.
